aboutSubtitleTechnical: Your Voice. Your Truth. Protected by Design.
missionPara1: VocalWitness na simple public square where anybody fit share wetin dem see — with proof say nobody modify am.
missionPara2: For world full of fake video and edited news, we dey give ordinary people safe place to post picture, voice note, and report. Everything dey protected so proof go stay original and your privacy go safe.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Every picture, voice note and document dey get unique digital fingerprint on your phone before uploading. People fit confirm say e real without seeing your secret details.
privacyFirstDesc: To talk na your choice always. We dey automatically remove location and phone details. Phone check na temporary thing to block spam, e no dey save publicly.
communityStewardshipDesc: Nobody singlehandedly dey decide wetin be truth. Trust dey grow through honest participation and clear reputation. We stay neutral.
communitySupportedDesc: VocalWitness dey alive through voluntary support. No ads, no paywalls, and no premium features locked behind money.
trustStep1Desc: Everybody dey start as Citizen. You fit upgrade your level with simple checks. Higher levels dey open stronger protection.
trustStep2Desc: Once something publish, e dey lock. Nobody fit quietly edit or delete original record.
trustStep3Desc: VocalWitness na neutral public square. We no dey edit post or push specific story. The evidence dey talk by itself.
aboutQuote: "For age of noise, the clearest voice na the one wetin fit prove say e never change."
privacySubtitle: Your privacy dey protected by strong technology — no be just mouth promises.
zkSubpoenaTitle: We No Fit Give Wetin We No Get
zkSubpoenaDesc: VocalWitness dey built so that your personal details no dey reach our server. If authority ask for your details, our answer na simple: We no get anything to give.
privacySec1Title: 1. Everything Important Dey Happen for Your Phone
privacySec1Para1: When you upload picture, voice note, or file, the work dey happen inside your browser before anything leaves your phone:
privacySec1Bullet1: Metadata vanish: Camera model, GPS location, and other secret details dey automatically clear.
privacySec1Bullet2: Digital fingerprint created: Your browser dey make unique fingerprint for the file. Only this fingerprint and clean media dey sent.
privacySec1Bullet3: Strong proof: You fit prove say you be real person without revealing your real name or details.
privacySec2Title: 2. Wetin We No Dey Collect or Store
privacySec2Intro: For maximum safety, we deliberately no dey keep:
privacySec2Item1: Your real IP address — requests dey pass through protection layers so location no dey linked to your post.
privacySec2Item2: Phone numbers on public record — phone checks na temporary to block spam, e no dey save or show.
privacySec2Item3: Government IDs, passports, biometrics, or contact list.
privacySec3Title: 3. Wetin We Dey Process (Only Essential Stuff)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Your chosen username, security keys, and trust badges.
privacyContentDesc: Your reports, clean media, digital fingerprints, and timestamps.
privacyVerificationDesc: Proof say you be real person — without revealing who you be.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous technical data used to block attacks and bots.
privacySec4Text: Our design dey follow Article 12 and 19 of Universal Declaration of Human Rights: everybody get right to privacy and freedom to share information without interference.
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness na technical host only. We no dey write, approve, or fact-check wetin people post.
privacySec5Text2: Every person dey fully responsible for wetin dem choose to publish.
privacySec6Title: 6. Wetin No Dey Allowed & How to Report
privacySec6Text1: Harassment, sharing person private details without consent, child abuse material, and deliberate fake harmful media dey strictly forbidden.
privacySec6Text2: If you see content wetin break these rules, abeg report am with the in-app button.
privacySec7Text: You fit instantly clear local browser data with Quick Exit button. But once report publish and lock, e don become permanent record.
privacySec8Text: VocalWitness platform, including software, design, name, and logo, na exclusive property of VocalWitness. You no fit copy or reuse without permission.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — public square where people fit share real report and proof with strong protection. As you dey use the platform, you agree to these simple rules.
termsSection1Text: By creating account, posting, or using VocalWitness, you agree to these Terms and Privacy Policy. If you no agree, abeg no use platform.
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness na neutral platform. We dey give people tools to publish report and protect evidence. We no be news publisher, we no dey decide wetin be truth, and we no be court.
termsSection3Intro: To keep square safe from bots and spam, we use simple levels of verification:
termsTier1: Open Tok — Open to everybody who sign up. Basic public discussion.
termsTier2: Citizen Circle — Unlocked with temporary phone check (used only to stop spam). Your phone number no dey saved publicly.
termsTier3: Higher Trust / Verified Tok — Highest level. Your file dey get digital fingerprint on your phone, secret details dey clear, and stronger protection dey apply.
termsSection4Intro: You stay in control of your voice. Here be the clear rules:
termsConduct1: Your Choice: You decide whether to talk publicly or stay private.
termsConduct2: Be Honest: Post only report and evidence wetin you genuinely believe say e true.
termsConduct3: No Doxxing or Harassment: No share other people private details. Targeted harassment no dey allowed.
termsConduct4: No Fake or Harmful Content: Creating deepfakes to harm person dey strictly forbidden.
termsSection5Text: You keep full ownership of everything you post. By publishing, you give VocalWitness permission to store and display your content. Once locked, e become part of permanent record.
termsSection6Text: We use trusted global services for secure storage and protection against attacks. The platform dey provided “as is”.
termsSection7Text: The platform dey supported by voluntary donations. Donations no dey give anybody special control or ownership.
termsSection8Text: To full extent allowed by law, VocalWitness no dey responsible for indirect damages wetin come from using platform or content posted by users.
termsSection9Title: 9. Your Responsibility for Wetin You Post
termsSection9Text: You dey responsible for wetin you publish. If person get issue with content, dem suppose use our reporting process.
termsSection10Text: All rights in VocalWitness platform, software, design, name, and logo, remain exclusive property of VocalWitness.
termsSection10Text2: You no fit copy, modify, or use any part of platform for commercial business without written permission.
divineNaturalLawDesc: Every person get right to share wetin dem see. This dey protected under Article 19 of Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
subpoenaDefenseDesc: We no fit give information wetin we never collect. Your identity dey stay protected.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: No identity logs linked to your public post.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: Location and phone details dey clear for browser before upload.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Strong technical protection for anonymous reporters.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Extra Safety Tips for High-Risk Situation
networkSafetySubDesc: For restricted area, use Tor or trusted VPN. Avoid publishing on networks linked to your government ID.
physicalSafetySubDesc: Use strong passcode. If danger dey, press the red Quick Exit button — e go clear local data and leave the site.
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Sharing person private details without permission.
safetyProhibit3: Fake or Altered Evidence meant to harm people.
safetySection4Text: Safety dey come from community report and clear verification levels:
safetyModTier1: Open Tok — Open discussion for everybody.
safetyModTier2: Higher Trust — Stronger protection and reputation.
safetyGoalText: Safe public square where real reports fit be shared and people dey protected by design.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once report publish, rules make am extremely hard for anybody to edit or delete original.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Database rules dey block update and delete on record.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Digital fingerprints dey created for your phone.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Records dey linked together for extra protection.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important: This na strong application-level protection, no be full public blockchain. Data dey live inside secure cloud storage.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Future option: We fit add extra public anchoring. This one never active yet.
legalBannerText: VocalWitness na decentralized medium wetin nobody dey manipulate. Verification dey check integrity hash, no be real-world truth.
verifyHeaderSubtitle: Press credential, ledger link, C2PA media, or JSON proof — confirm integrity references.
ledgerIdPlaceholder: Firestore ID or credential ID from PDF QR code
ledgerHashLabel: Ledger / forensic hash (h) — optional for credentials
verifyGuideIntro: VocalWitness dey check integrity only. Green result mean say nobody change data since dem record or sign am. E no dey prove say real-world event happen.
verifyGuideLedger: Paste Testimony/Credential ID (+ optional hash) → click Verify. Best for shared link and QR code.
verifyGuideC2PA: Drop picture or video → click Verify Media Provenance. E go check official Content Credentials inside file.
verifyGuideJSON: Paste full Evidence Pack JSON → click Verify payload. E go confirm say JSON itself no change.
verifyGuideFooter: No account needed. Always keep original file or JSON.
c2paEngineLoading: E dey load Content Credentials engine...
c2paEngineFailed: ⚠️ Content Credentials engine fail to load. You fit still try verify — or switch to Ledger / JSON tab.
ledger_info_desc: Every report dey cryptographically sealed and linked to ledger. Once published, nobody fit edit or delete original.
